title: www.lichtvision.com
description: Lichtvision specializes in innovative lighting design, focusing on architectural spaces through the use of daylight, artificial light, and immersive media technologies. With a team of 40 designers, architects, and engineers, they provide sustainable and aesthetically pleasing lighting solutions for a variety of projects, including museums, offices, and retail spaces. Established in 1997, Lichtvision has a global presence with studios in major cities and emphasizes a holistic approach to lighting that enhances the quality of life. Their work is characterized by a blend of creativity, technical expertise, and a commitment to ecological sustainability.
